resources.string: Place payment calls directly. You can also continue using your phone\'s dialer.
Scan a QR code with your camera. You can choose a QR image from your gallery instead.
Choose a saved contact to pay. You can enter a phone number manually instead.
This edition does not access SMS. Payment attempts remain Unverified in OffPay. Confirm the result in your bank\'s SMS or app before paying again.
